data.body: Windows evidence. Scheduled Test Suite (mirror) run 41282090856, job 'sweep (windows)' (124775894326), on d8801e4dda4, which contains the fix f13aaa04c2d. Whole job: 794 failed, 18580 passed, 637 skipped, 30 errors (other modules; tracked by majestic-depilatory-beetle). In its log, network-guard RuntimeError tracebacks: 0 (run 41230936309 before the fix had 364, 364 via _fallback_socketpair). Review-bot failures: 6, down from 84: test_review_bot.py::test_lifespan_can_opt_into_the_real_reconcile_loop, ::test_lifespan_is_safe_by_default_without_per_test_stubs, ::test_lifespan_starts_and_stops_snapshot_janitor, and test_review_bot_in_flight.py's 3 health-endpoint tests, all AttributeError: 'State' object has no attribute 'config'. Those are exactly the 6 tests zodiacal-rockbound-egret records for pytest 9.2.0 (pytest #14969/#15099, monkeypatch undo deletes app.state.config): the job runs 'platform win32 -- Python 3.13.16, pytest-9.2.0', because it installs with 'uv pip install ".[dev,reviewbot,ui]"' rather than from uv.lock (which pins 9.0.3). The last criterion is narrowed to this ticket's titled defect (the network guard's RuntimeError) and linked relates_to zodiacal-rockbound-egret for the remaining 6.
